response.original_title: แฟนจ๋า เดะมิวสิคัล
response.overview: This stage music weaves together over twenty of Bird Thongchai’s classic songs, into a heartwarming narrative of love, dreams, and memories. The story follows a couple who have known each other since childhood, enduring numerous trials and tribulations. Despite all obstacles, the enduring bond of love and connection remains unwavering over time.
response.title: แฟนจ๋า เดะมิวสิคัล
